title: Curio Trader
description: A shop in its own plugin window (nostalro-client), with a level up notification above the player. Bots can read the stock and buy.

greeting.default: Potions, wings and arrows, all at a fair price. Pick an amount, then press Buy.

max_amount.description: Most items of one kind bought at once.

level_up_overhead.description: Shows LEVEL UP above a player who levels up.

stock.description: Items on sale: item_id and price in zeny.
